decisions.reason: As a relatively low-cost, ecosystem-building extension in a growing and innovative firm, the accelerator still has option value despite being somewhat peripheral to the core machinery business.

The bitumen binder appears to be the least core to the firm's decentralized recycling-equipment offering and likely needs distinct market development, so management would be more willing to reallocate resources if early traction remains uncertain.
The infectious-waste decontamination plant is a close adjacent technology that was prominently launched, so its strategic fit and still-unresolved upside support keeping the option open.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant is highly aligned with the firm's modular decentralized recycling strategy and core manufacturing capabilities, making it the strongest candidate to retain.
